gloss: to burn; to scorch; to char

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {焦|こ}がしていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to burn; to scorch; to char
definitions.explanation: To apply too much heat to something, causing it to become burnt or charred on the surface. Often refers to accidentally burning food while cooking.

definitions.gloss: to be consumed by (emotion); to be burning with
definitions.explanation: To be intensely preoccupied or tormented by a strong emotion such as longing, jealousy, or impatience.

examples.japanese: ⟦フライパン→フライパン：01025_furaipan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{焦|こ}がして⟦しまった→しまう：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: I accidentally burned the meat in the frying pan.

examples.japanese: ⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{焦|こ}がさない⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧⟦{気|き}をつけて→気をつける：09771_kiwotsukeru⟧。
examples.english: Be careful not to burn the bread.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦まま→まま：02007_mama⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧、⟦{底|そこ}→底：12560_soko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{焦|こ}がして⟦しまった→しまう：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: I forgot the pot on the stove and scorched the bottom.
I'm spending my days burning with love.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{焦|こ}がし⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: Burning with longing for her, I wrote a letter.

notes:
・{焦|こ}がす → {焦|こ}がさない (negative)
・{焦|こ}がす → {焦|こ}がして (te-form)
・{焦|こ}がす → {焦|こ}がした (past)
・{焦|こ}がす → {焦|こ}がせる (potential)
・{焦|こ}がす → {焦|こ}がされる (passive)

TRANSITIVITY:
{焦|こ}がす is transitive: someone burns something.
Intransitive pair: ⟦{焦|こ}げる→焦げる：05344_kogeru⟧ (to get burnt, to scorch)
・⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{焦|こ}がした (I burned the bread) - transitive
・⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{焦|こ}げた→焦げる：05344_kogeru⟧ (The bread got burned) - intransitive

Sense 2 USAGE:
⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{焦|こ}がす - to be consumed/tormented by (emotion). This is a set phrase and is largely limited to written or literary style.
・⟦{恋|こい}→恋：02208_koi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{焦|こ}がす (to be burning with love)
・⟦{嫉妬|しっと}→嫉妬：05406_shitto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{焦|こ}がす (to be consumed by jealousy)
